title: gomphandra papuana
intro: Gomphandra papuana, commonly known as the Queensland forest pine or the small-leaved Gomphandra, is a species of flowering plant in the family Staphyladaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Gomphandra papuana include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
